sop_documents.title: SOP - Video storyboard (Phase 1)
sop_documents.contentText:
# Video storyboard (Phase 1)

1. CEO chats **Content Orchestrator** with idea + optional character refs.
2. Orchestrator calls **video_story_status** (and RAG). If any story is **pending_ceo_approval**, ask CEO to approve/reject that Kanban card before a new run.
3. Trigger **run video storyboard**: Story → **CEO cast** (lock character_id) → Scene → Prompt → **CEO storyboard** (PDF with character_id map).
4. Knowledge: video_storyboards status + RAG of story details/PDF; video_characters for reusable faces.
5. Scheduled goals: pass recent_titles_90d so Story avoids last 90 days titles.

Canonical templates: openclaw-workspace-templates/video-* /
Canonical graphs: company-blueprints/standard/video-content/

policy_templates.after_approval: Generate storyboards freely after cast+storyboard CEO gates; require CEO Kanban approval before Phase 2 Veo spend.
policy_templates.autonomous: Orchestrator must block new runs when a same/any title is pending_ceo_approval; may run W-Reasoning after clear status.
